blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A wing van that conked out in the middle of an uphill portion of the highway suddenly backed into its driver, who was underneath the vehicle trying to fix the truck, and ran over its foot. The wing van, which was loaded with 500 sacks of rice, continued to move backward without a driver and then fell into the side of a cliff, scattering the sacks of rice at the side and base of the cliff.
